messages:
Anya K: Final draft of the PRD SLO section is up — need a quick sanity check before I hand to eng. Focus areas: latency SLOs (p95/p99), error budget, and clear behavior for partial-region or GPU degradation. PTAL :eyes:

Kevin L: quick skim. My instinct: baseline hosted p95=200ms, p99=700ms for typical chat workloads. Error budget 0.5% over 24h. Dedicated customers configurable/tighter. Seems reasonable as a default.

Mira S: those p99 targets are fine for short contexts but will blow up for 2k+ sequences. We should make SLOs model-class aware (small/medium/large) and by sequence-length bucket. Also need a concrete degrade sequence (explicit order). e.g.:
1) apply prefix/KV cache warm path
2) reduce batching window
3) route to quantized variant or smaller model
4) if still >SLO, return 503 with structured fallback payload

Samir P: +1 to model/seq buckets. For rollout acceptance tests: canary at 5% traffic for 48h, watch token throughput, queue_wait_ms, batch_size, and KV cache hit rate. Abort conditions: error_rate > 0.8% OR p99 > 2x target for >10m.

deploy-bot: Deploy ticket created: INF-4123. Canary scheduled 2026-04-01T03:00Z. :rocket:

Elaine R: Heads-up — FinReg pilot asked for SLA p95=150ms in their region and strict audit logs. That's an enterprise add-on (pricing + Private deployment). Add acceptance criteria for opt-in SLA and KMS/HSM support.

Anya K: Adding explicit acceptance criteria into PRD now. Draft snippet below — please flag gaps.

```yaml
acceptance_criteria:
  - slo_profile: 'hosted_default'
    p95_latency_ms: '<=200'
    p99_latency_ms: '<=700'
    error_budget_24h_pct: '<=0.5'
    latency_buckets: ['<256','256-512','512-1024','>1024']
  - canary_policy:
    percent: 5
    duration_hours: 48
    abort_if:
      error_rate_pct: '>0.8'
      p99_multiple_of_target: '>2'
  - degrade_behavior_flow:
    - 'try_cache'
    - 'reduce_batch_window'
    - 'route_to_model_variant'
    - 'return_structured_503'
```

Kevin L: Add these metrics to dashboards: token_latency_ms (per model), queue_wait_ms, batch_size, kv_hit_rate, router_retries. Also ensure we surface "reason for degrade" in traces.

Mira S: Edge cases: very long single-request generation (>=8k tokens) -> tail latency spikes and OOM risk. Acceptance should include max_tokens_per_request=8192 and automatic truncation with user-visible warning + telemetry tag (truncation=true). Also specify fallback content for truncated prompts.

Samir P: For resilience tests, add chaos scenario: simulate loss of 30% GPU capacity in region for 10m and verify graceful degrade path (route + model-variant) keeps error_rate under 2% for tiered customers. Put this in e2e/chaos-playbook.

Elaine R: For customer prioritization: add a short table in PRD mapping customers -> required SLAs and commercial notes. FinReg = SLA+private+KMS, Startup X = best-effort hosted (no SLA).

Anya K: Great. Action items: (1) Kevin to add dashboards & trace tags (by EOD), (2) Mira to propose model-class SLO breakpoints + max_tokens rule (tomorrow), (3) Samir to add canary + chaos test definitions in INF-4123, (4) Elaine to add customer-SLA mapping in PRD. I'll update the PRD and ping eng on readiness. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Kevin L: working on dashboards now.

Mira S: will draft breakpoints and edge-case text.

Samir P: adding tests to INF-4123.

deploy-bot: Canary window reserved: 2026-04-01 03:00Z -> 2026-04-03 03:00Z (5% traffic).
